Name: Useful Bombs
Author: yakminepunyo
Description:
[size=4][b][OVERVIEW][/b]
This mod changes explosion behavior, and adds some new features: 'Modify Damages To Enemies', 'Break Boulders',
﻿'Collect Crystals', 'Larger Radius', and 'Cancel Enemy Invincibility'.
[i]﻿'Modify Damages To Enemies' [/i]modifies damage to enemies, so it makes bombs to be usable as a weapon.

﻿These features won't work outside of mines(e.g. Quarry, Farm House).

[list]
[*]﻿'[i]Break Boulders' [/i]let bombs be able to break boulders.
[/list][list]
[*][i]﻿'Collect Crystals' [/i]let objects which can be grabbed(like crystals, and mushrooms) collectible with explosion.
[/list][list]
[*]﻿'Larger Radius' increases bomb radius, but note that it also increases damages and it can cause death easily.
[/list][list]
[*]﻿'Cancel Enemy Invincibility' let bombs remove enemy's invincibility. For example, breaks armor of armored bug, 
[/list] ﻿and mummies killed with bombs won't revive.

﻿This mod requires SMAPI to be loaded.
﻿There are two versions of this mod, 'for 1.2' and 'for 1.3' . Please select one (which game version you using).

[b][CONFIG][/b]
Configuration file(config.json) will be generated when there is no config.json available.
[/size] ﻿[size=4][b][i]ModifyDamagesToEnemies [/i](bool, default:true) - [/b]Enable/Disable 'Modify Damages To Enemies'
[b][i]﻿BreakBoulders[/i](bool, default:true) [/b][b]- [/b]Enable/Disable 'Break Boulders'
[b][i]﻿CollectCrystals[/i](bool, default:false) [/b][b]- [/b]Enable/Disable 'Collect Crystals'
[b][i] ﻿﻿LargerRadius[/i](bool, default:false) [/b][b]- [/b]Enable/Disable 'Collect Crystals'
[b][i] ﻿CancelEnemyInvincibility[/i][/b][b](bool, default:false) [/b][b]- [/b]Enable/Disable 'Cancel Enemy Invincibility'
[b][i]DamageMultiplier[/i][/b]﻿[b](float, default:3.0, min:1.0, max:3.0) [/b][b]- [/b]Damage multiplier of 'Modify Damages To Enemies'
[b][i] ﻿RadiusIncreaseRatio[/i](float, default:0.5, min:0.1, max:0.5) [/b][b]- [/b]Radius increase ratio for ﻿'Larger Radius'
